text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Pendidikan

(Penggal Institusi Pendidikan Kalendar Akademik 2022/2023) 2021.

Pemakaian

2. Peraturan-Peraturan ini hendaklah terpakai bagi kehadiran di institusi pendidikan

bagi kalendar akademik 2022/2023.

Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan

3. Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan bagi kalendar akademik 2022/2023 adalah

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Kumpulan A Penggal Pertama

Semua institusi pendidikan di Johor,

Kedah, Kelantan dan Terengganu

21 Mac 2022 hingga 2 Jun 2022

Penggal Kedua

12 Jun 2022 hingga 1 September 2022

Penggal Ketiga

11 September 2022 hingga 8 Disember 2022

1 Januari 2023 hingga 16 Februari 2023

Kumpulan B Penggal Pertama

Semua institusi pendidikan di Melaka,

Negeri Sembilan, Pahang, Perak, Perlis,

Pulau Pinang, Sabah, Sarawak,

Selangor, Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala

Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan

dan Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya

21 Mac 2022 hingga 3 Jun 2022

Penggal Kedua

13 Jun 2022 hingga 2 September 2022

Penggal Ketiga

12 September 2022 hingga 9 Disember 2022

3 Januari 2023 hingga 17 Februari 2023

Dibuat 12 November 2021

[KPM.PUU.S.100-1/19/8(25); PN(PU2)569/XIV]

DATUK DR. MOHD RADZI BIN MD JIDIN

Menteri Kanan Pendidikan

EDUCATION ACT 1996

EDUCATION (TERMS OF EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS

ACADEMIC CALENDAR 2022/2023) REGULATIONS 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 130(2)(b) of the

Education Act 1996 [Act 550], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Education (Terms of Educational

Institutions Academic Calendar 2022/2023) Regulations 2021.

Application

2. These Regulations shall apply to attendance at educational institutions for the

academic calendar 2022/2023.

Duration of terms of educational institutions

3. The duration of terms of educational institutions for the academic

calendar 2022/2023 shall be as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Group A First Term

All educational institutions in Johore,

Kedah, Kelantan and Terengganu

21 March 2022 to 2 June 2022

Second Term

12 June 2022 to 1 September 2022

Third Term

11 September 2022 to 8 December 2022

1 January 2023 to 16 February 2023

Group B First Term

All educational institutions in Malacca,

Negeri Sembilan, Pahang, Perak, Perlis,

Penang, Sabah, Sarawak, Selangor,

Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur,

Federal Territory of Labuan and

Federal Territory of Putrajaya

21 March 2022 to 3 June 2022

Second Term

13 June 2022 to 2 September 2022

Third Term

12 September 2022 to 9 December 2022

 3 January 2023 to 17 February 2023

Made 12 November 2021

[KPM.PUU.S.100-1/19/8(25); PN(PU2)569/XIV]

DATUK DR. MOHD RADZI BIN MD JIDIN

Senior Minister of Education
